setting.sl: V Beljaku si {m:našel|f:našla} oglas: rabljena škoda octavia karavan, letnik 2015, 168.000 kilometrov, 8.900 evrov, tehnični pregled (v Avstriji: das Pickerl) velja do marca. Prodajalec je zasebnik. Avto si dobro ogledaš in se pogajaš za ceno.
setting.en: In Villach you found an ad: a second-hand Škoda Octavia estate, 2015, 168,000 kilometres, 8,900 euros, its inspection sticker (in Austria, the Pickerl) valid until March. The seller is a private person. You look the car over carefully and haggle over the price.
setting.it: A Villaco hai trovato un annuncio: una Škoda Octavia station wagon usata del 2015, 168.000 chilometri, 8.900 euro, la revisione (in Austria il Pickerl) valida fino a marzo. Il venditore è un privato. Guardi bene la macchina e tratti sul prezzo.

role: Herr Gasser, a private seller in Villach, showing his 2015 Škoda Octavia estate (8,900 euros). Friendly and proud of it, but a seller: plays down each fault (worn winter tyres, a dent, a clutch that bites late), comes down in small steps, prefers cash and a written contract. Says Sie.

goals.en: Ask precise questions about the car

goals.de: Sprich die Mängel an, die du findest
goals.en: Point out the faults you find
goals.it: Fai notare i difetti che trovi

goals.de: Mach ein Angebot und begründe es
goals.en: Make an offer and give your reasons

goals.de: Verhandle Schritt für Schritt bis zu einer Einigung
goals.sl: Pogajaj se korak za korakom do dogovora
goals.en: Negotiate step by step to an agreement
goals.it: Tratta passo dopo passo fino a un accordo

goals.de: Fass den Handel zusammen: Preis, Reifen, Vertrag
goals.en: Sum up the deal: the price, the tyres, the contract

opener_sl: Grüß Gott! Sie kommen wegen dem Škoda, oder? Da steht er. Gepflegt, Nichtraucherauto, immer in der Garage gestanden. Schauen Sie ihn sich ruhig an.

opener_en.sl: Dober dan! Prišli ste zaradi škode, kajne? Tam stoji. Lepo vzdrževan, v njem se ni kadilo, vedno je stal v garaži. Kar dobro si ga oglejte.
opener_en.en: Good morning! You've come about the Škoda, haven't you? There it is. Well looked after, a non-smoker's car, always kept in the garage. Take a good look at it.
opener_en.it: Buongiorno! È {m:venuto|f:venuta} per la Škoda, vero? Eccola. Tenuta bene, mai fumato dentro, sempre in garage. La guardi pure con calma.

vocabulary_hints.sl: Wie viele Kilometer hat er genau?

en.en: Exactly how many kilometres has it done?

vocabulary_hints.sl: Bis wann hat er noch Pickerl?

en.en: How long is its inspection sticker valid?
en.it: Fino a quando vale la revisione?

vocabulary_hints.sl: Kann ich das Serviceheft und den Typenschein sehen?

en.sl: Lahko vidim servisno knjižico in dokumente avta?
en.en: Can I see the service book and the car's papers (Typenschein)?
en.it: Posso vedere il libretto dei tagliandi e i documenti dell'auto?

en.en: May I take it for a test drive?
en.it: Posso fare un giro di prova?

en.en: The winter tyres are pretty worn.
en.it: Le gomme invernali sono piuttosto consumate.

vocabulary_hints.sl: Wegen der Delle und der Reifen müsste der Preis runter.

en.sl: Zaradi udrtine in gum bi morala cena dol.
en.en: Because of the dent and the tyres, the price ought to come down.
en.it: Per l'ammaccatura e le gomme il prezzo dovrebbe scendere.

vocabulary_hints.sl: Treffen wir uns in der Mitte?

en.en: Shall we meet in the middle?
en.it: Ci veniamo incontro a metà strada?

vocabulary_hints.sl: Wenn die Sommerreifen dabei sind, nehme ich ihn.

en.sl: Če dobim zraven še letne gume, ga vzamem.
en.en: If the summer tyres are included, I'll take it.
en.it: Se ci sono anche le gomme estive, la prendo.

en.en: Let's put the sale in a written contract.
en.it: Facciamo un contratto di vendita scritto.
